issue.title: bob-ledger-tools adopts the shared requirement recognizer twin
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-on.10.1.6 (note #2, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP).

Epic bob-cli-on.10.1 shipped one plugin-agnostic requirement recognizer twin (RQ: bob-plugins plugins/task-status-cycler/src/194-task-reqs-lines-twin.js + 195-task-reqs-twin.js), copied byte for byte into bob-navigation-hotkeys (694/695) and block-id-prompt (165/166) and enforced by scripts/test-task-reqs-twin-copies.cjs. bob-ledger-tools still carries its own display-only RQ subset (src/139-task-reqs.js, from bob-cli-on.9) without path, subtree_end, note ranges, or row keys. The twin's row field names were kept a strict superset of ledger-tools' (line, lineIndex, depth, parent, owner, ownerLine, ownerText, ownerName, mark, markChar, state, text, anchor, depth_exceeded, excludedBy, excludedBecause, markerFrom, markerTo) precisely so ledger-tools could adopt it.

Proposal: replace bob-ledger-tools' 139-task-reqs.js with byte-identical copies of the RQ twin fragments, port its callers (req marks rendering, freshness guards) to the twin's API, add ledger-tools to the copy/drift assertions in scripts/test-task-reqs-twin-copies.cjs, and run every RQ vector through the built ledger-tools bundle. One recognizer means future bob-cli RQ changes land in all four plugins with one copy.

task_type_fields.proposal: Replace bob-ledger-tools src/139-task-reqs.js with byte-identical copies of the cycler's RQ twin fragments (194/195), port its callers, and extend scripts/test-task-reqs-twin-copies.cjs to cover ledger-tools.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The obsidian-gestures plan (plan:202611/obsidian_req_gestures.md) put bob-ledger-tools explicitly out of scope; its rendering and freshness guards had already landed in bob-cli-on.9.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-on.10.1.6 proposed it after the epic shipped byte-identical RQ twins to three plugins while bob-ledger-tools kept its own partial recognizer.
